start: Owner signed in, gym online, web pages switched on, no page made yet. Menu group 'Your gym', row 'Your web page'

steps.action: Open 'Your web page'
user_sees: Title 'Your web page'
Status line 'Not made yet. Fill in the parts below, then publish.'
Box 'Page address' already filled from the gym's name, and under it 'Your page: join.mettleup.fit/<address>'
must_not: The editor shown for a gym that is not online
An empty address box that the owner has to invent

steps.action: Type Area 'Sector 12' and City 'Jaipur'
user_sees: The address under the box changes to include the area
Sections 'Where your gym is', 'About your gym', 'What your gym has', 'Photos'
must_not: The address changing again after the owner typed his own address
A locked address before the page was ever published

steps.action: Type a few lines in About, tick three facilities, tap '+ Add photos' and choose two photos
user_sees: Letter count under About with 'No web addresses.'
'Adding a photo…', then each photo with a box 'Photo 1: what it shows (optional)' and buttons 'Move up' and 'Remove'
must_not: The Save button usable while a photo is still being added
A photo sent with its location data
More than 6 photos kept

steps.action: Tick 'Show my page to visitors', tick 'These fees, photos and words are my gym’s own, and I am responsible for them.', tap 'Save and publish'
user_sees: Button reads 'Saving…'
Toast 'Published. Your page is ready.'
Status 'Published. People can open your page.' with the address
Buttons 'Copy link' and 'Share on WhatsApp'
The address is now plain text with 'The address stays the same once the page is published…'
must_not: A page published without the owner's tick on the terms line
Two saves from a double tap
A success toast when the server refused the save

start: Owner on 'Set up your gym', the step for the web page (exact step words not read: unknown)

steps.action: Tap the web page step
user_sees: The same 'Your web page' screen with its status card and editor
must_not: The step shown while web pages are switched off
A different, second editor for the same page

steps.action: Fill the parts and tap 'Save' without ticking 'Show my page to visitors'
user_sees: Toast 'Saved. Your page is not published.'
Status 'Saved, not published. Visitors cannot see it.'
must_not: The page opened to visitors without the publish tick
The setup step still showing as not done after a save (unknown how the step reads it)

start: Owner in the web page editor with wrong or missing input

steps.action: Clear the page address, or type letters that are not allowed, and tap 'Save'
user_sees: Red words under 'Page address' (exact words live in the page logic: unknown)
Banner 'Fix the parts marked in red, then save again.'
must_not: A save sent to the server with a bad address
The red words staying after the box is fixed

steps.action: Paste a web address into About, or a link that is not Google Maps into 'Google Maps link (optional)', tap 'Save'
user_sees: Red words under About / under the map link
Banner 'Fix the parts marked in red, then save again.'
must_not: A web address shown on the public page
The whole form cleared

steps.action: Tick 'Show my page to visitors' on a page never published, leave the terms line unticked, tap 'Save and publish'
user_sees: Red words under the terms tick
Nothing is published
must_not: The page going public without the terms tick

steps.action: Pick an address another gym already uses and save
user_sees: Red words under 'Page address' naming the address as taken (the server's SLUG_TAKEN answer)
must_not: Another gym's page overwritten
A plain 'could not be saved' with no hint which box is wrong

steps.action: Choose 8 photos at once
user_sees: 'A page has at most 6 photos. Remove one to add another.'
Only the photos that fit are added
must_not: A 7th photo kept
The first photos lost

steps.action: Open the screen with the gym not online
user_sees: 'Your web page needs your gym online' and 'The page is made from your gym’s records on its server. Put your gym online first (Settings → Sign-in & data).'
must_not: An editor whose Save can never work

start: Owner, page saved but never published

steps.action: Look at the status card
user_sees: 'Saved, not published. Visitors cannot see it.'
The address box can still be changed
must_not: Share buttons shown for a page nobody can open

steps.action: Tick 'Show my page to visitors', tick the terms line, tap 'Save and publish'
user_sees: Toast 'Published. Your page is ready.'
Address locked
must_not: The terms tick asked again on later saves

steps.action: Change the About text and tap 'Save'
user_sees: Toast 'Saved. Your page shows the changes.'
Then 'All changes saved.' next to a greyed Save button
must_not: Save usable when nothing changed
The old About still on the public page

steps.action: Untick 'Show my page to visitors' and tap 'Save'
user_sees: Toast 'Saved. Your page is not published.'
Status 'Saved, not published. Visitors cannot see it.'
'Copy link' and 'Share on WhatsApp' are gone
The address stays locked
must_not: The page still open to visitors
The address free to change, breaking links already shared

steps.action: MettleUp takes the page down, the owner opens the screen again
user_sees: Red banner 'MettleUp has taken your page down, so visitors cannot see it.' with MettleUp’s note and 'Fix what the note says, then write to MettleUp from Help and feedback to put it back.'
Status 'Taken down by MettleUp.'
must_not: The status saying 'Published' while visitors cannot open it
Share buttons shown

start: Owner in the editor, deciding what strangers may see

steps.action: Read the card 'Also on your page, from your other screens'
user_sees: Rows Fees, Timings, 'Name, logo and colours', Address, each with 'Open'
'Change them there and your page changes too. Members, money and staff never show on the page.'
must_not: A member's name, a payment or a staff name on the public page

steps.action: Leave 'Show my gym’s phone number, with a Call button' unticked and save
user_sees: The WhatsApp tick is greyed
'Questions sent from your page come to Enquiries either way.'
must_not: The gym's phone number on the public page
A WhatsApp button without the phone tick

steps.action: Leave 'Let Google list my page' unticked and publish
user_sees: The page opens by its link
must_not: The page offered to Google search while the tick is off

steps.action: Add a photo taken on a phone
user_sees: 'Each photo is made smaller on this device, and its location data is taken out before it is sent.'
must_not: The photo's place data reaching the server
A photo visible to visitors while the page is not published or is taken down

start: Front desk login, gym online, web pages on. Menu row 'Your web page'

steps.action: Open 'Your web page'
user_sees: Title 'Your web page'
Status line, for example 'Published. People can open your page.', and the page address
'Only the owner can change the web page.'
must_not: Any text box, photo button, publish tick or Save button
The About text, photos or phone settings shown for editing

start: Front desk login, things not ready

steps.action: Open the screen with the gym not online
user_sees: 'Your web page needs your gym online'
must_not: An endless 'Loading…'

steps.action: Open the screen's address when MettleUp has switched this gym's page off or the gym server is older
user_sees: The Settings screen opens instead
must_not: A blank screen
Words such as 'not open yet'

steps.action: Open the screen with no internet
user_sees: Words such as 'Your web page could not be opened. Check your internet and try again.' and a 'Try again' button
must_not: A status from another gym
A crash

start: Front desk login, the page in each of its states

steps.action: Open the screen before the owner made a page
user_sees: 'Not made yet. Fill in the parts below, then publish.' and 'Only the owner can change the web page.'
must_not: Parts to fill in shown to the desk

steps.action: Open it after the owner saved without publishing
user_sees: 'Saved, not published. Visitors cannot see it.' and the address
must_not: 'Published' shown

steps.action: Open it after the owner published
user_sees: 'Published. People can open your page.' and the address
must_not: A stale 'not published' kept from the last visit after the fresh answer arrives

steps.action: Open it after MettleUp took the page down
user_sees: Red banner 'MettleUp has taken your page down, so visitors cannot see it.' and 'Taken down by MettleUp.'
must_not: 'Published' shown while visitors cannot open it

start: Front desk login on 'Your web page'

steps.action: Look at everything the screen shows
user_sees: Only the status, the address and, when taken down, MettleUp's note
'Only the owner can change the web page.'
must_not: The desk able to save the page by any route (the server lets only the owner save)
The owner's terms tick or its time shown
